column1: # The realisable bases of the PSP seeded corpus, one per line: id, path from
# the repository root, source, and optionally max_candidates (how many
# candidates seed.py draws; set on the SYNTECH17 lines, where each check
# costs a whole-specification realize). The SYNTECH17 lines (since 22 Nov)
# are the lifted realisable imports that realize decides in at most 1 s and
# that have a weakenable guarantee, 26 of the 51. Their ids carry the prefix
# syntech-lift-, so no subject id repeats one from the earlier import. They
# were seeded apart from the hand-written lines (2026-11-20-psp-seeded-corpus
# PLAN.md, log of 22 Nov), so the hand-written rows are those of 20 Nov.
